name: What should I do to prepare my home for original trim restoration services?

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare my home for original trim restoration services?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare your home for original trim restoration, you should clear the work areas by moving furniture and decorative items away from the trim. Remove any wall hangings, curtains, or blinds near the trim. If possible, consider removing delicate items from adjacent rooms to protect them from dust. This preparation allows our team to work efficiently and safely. We also appreciate knowing about any existing plumbing or electrical considerations near the trim areas to avoid unexpected issues during the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare for trim restoration by clearing work areas of furniture and decor, and removing wall hangings. This helps our team work efficiently and safely.
